Named after Tom Tucker, a well-known South Florida marine construction and boating figure. Part fishing competition, part networking getaway for boating, marina, marine construction, and yachting industry people from Florida and the Bahamas. Typical format: Thursday: Captain’s Party / Welcome Reception. Friday: Main fishing day. Friday evening: Weigh-in and awards. Saturday: Social raft-up, usually around Honeymoon Harb

Come and experience our unique Bahamian parade and join in! Hear us make music with horns, goat skin drums, cowbells and other percussive instruments as we “rush” and dance in colourful, fringed costumes. Held at the Craft Center, Alice Town.
